Key Concepts: ADA’s Standardized 
Nutrition Care Process
The four steps of the nutrition care
process are:
• Nutrition Assessment
• Nutrition Diagnosis
• Nutrition Intervention
• Nutrition Monitoring and Evaluation
By using the nutrition care process,
dietetics practitioners can demonstrate
that nutrition care improves outcomes
because it:
• Is a systematic method used to make 
decisions to provide safe and effective
care.
• Provides a common language for 
documenting and communicating the 
impact of nutrition care.
• Relies on an evidence-based 
approach.
• Uses speciﬁ c critical thinking skills 
for each step.
